Field Data Lab uses empirical analysis of real-world data to draw behavioral insights. Field data shows how
people, and the systems they build, actually decide when the stakes are real: on the playing field, on the shop
floor, along a supply chain. Lab studies show what people say they would do.

Each article states its question, its data and its method. The code behind any article is available on request.
